expectations.text: Closes with a funder narrative of at most five sentences containing no devrel jargon.
expectations.evidence: A "Narrative for the funder" section exists and is exactly five sentences, plainly worded ("making it fast for a developer to go from signup to a working integration"). Two problems: (1) it is not the closing section — it is followed by a "Quality gate — self-check" section plus a closing paragraph, so the document does not end on the narrative; (2) it leaks devrel/program jargon: "Discord" plus "scaling it," and "Fifteen percent stays unallocated" reads as internal budget vocabulary rather than funder-facing plain language. The self-check even asserts "Narrative: five sentences, no devrel jar
